app.name: Gekko2 SPEED BETA12.23 VU/VIF/UV
app.version: BETA12.23 - VU masks, VIF interlocks, UV, 4:3
app.long_description: Experimental PS2 emulator for Wii. Corrected VU integer memory lane masks, VIF microprogram interlocks and fractional GS UV coordinates. Standard 4:3 presentation is fitted on widescreen Wii. Chain residency and experimental PSM conversion remain factory OFF and apply at Cold Boot. No confirmed Wii gameplay, Crash stall fix or overall FPS gain. Bring your own legal BIOS and disc.
